messages:
Ravi (Design): Heads-up: thinking about adding a tiny confirmation nudge when toggling A/B forks or bumping a canary. Not a modal for every change, but something in-between. Ideas: inline inline-popover with 'Are you sure? 10% -> 25%' and an undo CTA.

Lena (PM): We should avoid modal fatigue. Support reported users accidentally toggling during quick edits. Popover + short undo sounds good. Need to surface risk level (low/medium/high) depending on delta.

Carlos (Frontend): Popover approach is lightweight. Implementation note: keep focus on the original control, don't steal. Use role="status" for the popover so it doesn't require focus trap. But for high-risk changes (>30% or 100%) escalate to modal.

Nia (A11y): Caution: role="status" may not be announced by all SRs reliably. For transient confirmations, `aria-live="polite"` + an explicit SR-only message is safer. If we escalate to modal, use alertdialog and focus trap.

Ravi (Design): Copy proposals for the popover:
- Primary line: "Confirm change: route 15% -> 25% to v3?"
- Subline: "Undo available for 2 minutes"
- Primary CTAs: [Confirm] [Cancel] with Confirm secondary style (subtle).
Which wording feels clear?

Lena (PM): Tweak to: "Confirm: route 15% 1 -> 25% to v3?" (remove extra words). And use 'Undo within 2 min' (short).

Carlos (Frontend): Also suggest a micro tooltip on hover over the percentage control: shows current latency and error rate for the selected variant. Helps ops make quick decisions without leaving flow.

Nia (A11y): Tooltip must be keyboard accessible (focusable) and avoid hover-only cues. Provide a focusable question mark button with aria-describedby reference to the tooltip content.

Ravi (Design): Motion: subtle slide-up of popover, respect prefers-reduced-motion. Visual affordance: highlight the timeline lane briefly with 1s fade to draw attention.

Carlos (Frontend): CSS sketch:
```
.popover { transform: translateY(6px); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .18s ease, transform .18s ease; }
.popover.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .popover { transition: none; } }
```

Lena (PM): Ops request: log every confirm action with reason + user id to help postmortems. Also require extra confirmation for scheduled rollouts that bypass canary.

deploy-bot: Note: recent rollout v3 -> 25% completed (job 9932).

Nia (A11y): Final a11y checklist for this flow: 1) popover text available via aria-live for SRs, 2) tooltip has keyboard target and `aria-describedby`, 3) modal uses alertdialog and focus trap for high-risk changes. I'll draft the checklist.

Ravi (Design): Great. I'll drop final copy and micro-interaction spec into the Figma frame and tag frontend. @Carlos please flag any layout constraints.

Carlos (Frontend): Got it. I'll prototype the popover and tooltip, link a PR.

Lena (PM): I'll align on product rules for when to escalate to modal (>30% or direct to 100%). Thanks all :rocket:
